title: No test checks that the front desk never sees the day's shop takings
what: The Shop today card on Today is never opened by any test as front-desk staff. Nothing checks that the 'sold today' money figure is left out for the desk, that only two figures show, or what the desk sees when the shop is off.
expected: A test signs in as the desk with orders waiting and handed over, and checks two figures, no rupee amount, and the shop-off line without the turn-on button.
who: gyms with front-desk staff and a shop
fix_line: Add a desk test of the Shop today card

title: The Shop today card's loading, shop-off and live update are never tested on screen
what: Tests check the order sums as data and that a 'new order' label appears. No test checks the '…' shown while orders load (and never 0), the card for a gym without the shop, the count rising by itself within the poll time, the sold today amount on the card, or that the Shop page shows the same count.
expected: A screen test with orders in each state checks the three figures, the loading dots, the shop-off card, a new order arriving, and the match with the Shop page.
fix_line: Add a Shop today card test for each state

title: Two shop cards are never tested: Branding before the app is on, and after the shop is disconnected
what: No test opens Branding in a gym whose member app is not on, so the 'Turn on the member app first' card is never checked. No test disconnects the shop of a real gym and checks the 'Shop disconnected' words, that members and payments stay, and what happens to the gym code after turning it on again.
expected: One test opens Branding with the app off and turns it on from there; another disconnects the shop and checks the words, the kept records and the code message.
who: owners turning the shop on or off

title: No test checks that starting a demo or turning the shop on sends no member details
what: The only check is that the gym's name goes to the server when the shop is turned on. No test checks that no member name, phone or payment is sent, or that the key that opens the gym never shows on screen or in a link.
expected: A test records every call made when the demo starts and when the shop is turned on, and checks only the gym name, code and sample products leave the browser.
who: owners and people trying the demo
how_often: every demo and every shop turn-on
fix_line: Assert the full payload sent on both

title: Coming back to a demo, and a demo that has gone, are never tested
what: No test returns to a browser that started a demo and checks the same gym and code open again. No test checks the 'That demo gym is no longer available' path, the empty gym left behind, or that a tap on Start demo makes only one gym; the shared helper taps a second time when the first seems lost.
expected: Tests reload after a demo starts and check the same code; remove the demo on the pretend server and check the words and the way back; count demo gyms made per tap.

title: Renaming the gym is never tested on screen
what: Only the server rules are tested: the owner may rename, the desk and other gyms may not. No test types a new gym name in Settings and checks 'Saved.', the new name at the top, the join code and other details unchanged, the empty-name words, a refused save, or the staff page without the name box.
expected: A screen test renames the gym, checks the words and the header, tries an empty name and a refused save, and opens Settings as staff.
fix_line: Add a gym rename screen test

title: Adding a product photo is never tested on screen
what: Product photo checks are all data checks: file types, sizes, names and error words. No test picks a photo on the Products tab or in the product sheet and checks 'Uploading…', 'Photo added to …', Save kept off while it uploads, the photo upright, the product's price and stock unchanged, or the words for a failed upload.
expected: A screen test adds, replaces and removes a product photo, tries a wrong file and no internet, and checks the words and the product after each.
fix_line: Add a product photo screen test

title: Checking in a member from another branch is never tested on screen as the front desk
what: The screen test of this card runs as the owner. The desk is checked only on the server. No test signs in as a desk person and checks the lookup words, the check-in toast, Undo, or that the desk sees only first name and branch.
expected: A test signs in as the desk of one branch and checks in a member of the other branch, then undoes it.
who: front desk at gyms with branches
fix_line: Add a desk test of the visitor card

title: The visitor card's undo, double tap, wrong number and limit are never tested on screen
what: The owner test checks a found member, the toast and a branch-only member. No test taps Undo, taps Check in twice fast, types a short number, looks up an unknown number, a member with no plan, or the 31st lookup, and checks the words on screen.
expected: Screen tests cover each of these cases with their words.
who: front desk at gyms with branches
fix_line: Add the edge cases to the visitor test

title: All branches is never tested when one branch fails, after a new payment, or from More on a phone
what: The only screen test opens All branches through the branch picker with both branches loading. No test makes one branch fail and checks the red banner and the totals of the others, saves a payment elsewhere and checks the figures move, or opens the page from the More row.
expected: Tests fail one branch on purpose, add a payment on another and refresh, and open the page from More.
fix_line: Add failure, refresh and More tests

title: Switching branch while offline or with unsent entries is never tested
what: No test turns the internet off, or leaves entries waiting to be sent, and checks that the branch list is greyed out with its line. The fault that All branches can switch while entries wait is already listed; no test would catch it.
expected: A test with entries waiting checks the list is off and the 'Another branch opens when everything saved on this device is sent.' line, also from All branches.

title: The add-branch test locks in the wrong words '1 plans were copied'
what: When one plan is copied to a new branch, the card says '1 plans were copied to it.' The test checks for exactly that line, so it passes on the wrong grammar and would fail if the words were fixed.
expected: With one plan the card says '1 plan was copied to it.', and the test checks that.
fix_line: Use the singular for one plan and fix the test

title: Add a branch refusals and the not-ready cards are never tested on screen
what: The server refusals (empty name, name taken, eleventh branch) are tested as data only. No test checks their words in the sheet, the card for a gym not online or without branches on the server, or closing the sheet without saving.
expected: Screen tests open the sheet for each refusal and each not-ready gym and check the words.

title: Renaming the business of a gym with branches is never tested on screen
what: Only the server rename is tested. No test types a new business name in Settings, Branches and checks 'Saving…', 'Saved.', the new name on All branches, Save off for the same or an empty name, or a failed save. The server also signs out this owner's keys for the other branches on a rename, and no screen test checks All branches still loads after it.
expected: A screen test renames the business, then opens All branches and another branch.
fix_line: Add a business rename screen test

title: The Payments page is never tested as the front desk
what: No test opens Settings, Payments signed in as desk staff. Nothing checks the desk sees the UPI ready line without connect buttons, or the add words without the 'Add UPI ID' button.
expected: A desk test opens Payments with and without a UPI ID and checks the words and the missing owner buttons.
fix_line: Add a desk test of Payments

title: The Payments page with no UPI ID, or a wrong one, is never tested
what: The only test of the page saves a good UPI ID first. No test opens it with no ID or a wrong one and checks the 'Add your gym’s UPI ID in Gym details' words and the 'Add UPI ID' button, or removes the ID and checks the page goes back.
expected: A test opens Payments with no ID, with 'abc', and after removing a saved ID.

title: Saving Branding, a failed save and going back to MettleUp's look are never checked on screen
what: Branding tests upload logos and pick colours, but none checks the 'Saved. New members see it at once…' words, the 'Saved' date by the button, the words for a save that failed with picks kept, or the 'Use MettleUp’s look' clear with its question.
expected: Screen tests save, fail a save, and clear the look, and check the words after each.
fix_line: Add save, failure and clear checks

title: Half the logo colour lines are never checked on screen
what: The screen test checks the dark-screen line only. No test checks the white member card line, 'Members see it after you press Save.', the 'Reading the colours' line, a logo whose colours cannot be read, or Branding with no logo.
expected: The colour test checks each line and the two no-suggestion states.
fix_line: Add the missing lines to the colour test
